format: Traditional restaurant (about 2,200 sq ft) in an in-line or endcap retail plaza space; freestanding building costs more (up to $1,968,450)

invest.quote: Total Initial Investment – Endcap and Inline23 $644,425 $1,401,650 Total Initial Investment – Freestanding23 $644,425 $1,968,450

fee.quote: When you sign your Franchise Agreement you must pay us an initial franchise fee (the “Initial Franchise Fee”) of $35,500.
fee.note: VetFran: Initial Franchise Fee is $20,000 for qualifying veterans or members of the Armed Forces. Reductions possible case by case (existing operators, reopening a closed Restaurant, multi-unit operators). During 2025 franchisees paid Initial Franchise Fees ranging from $4,500 to $20,500. Grand opening advertising minimum $25,000 ($35,000 if first in a Designated Market Area).

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee 5% of Net Sales. Payable weekly on the date specified in the Manuals (the “Payment Due Date”)

adFund.quote: Advertising Contribution Currently, 3% of Net Sales, but it may be increased to up to 4% of Net Sales.
adFund.note: Currently 3%, up to 4% of Net Sales. Local Marketing Obligation: currently not less than 1% of Net Sales each calendar quarter. Advertising Cooperative contribution may also apply.

otherRecurring.name: POS System License and Lease Fees
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $159 to $454 per month under the CapEx Program and $332 to $902 per month under the HaaS Program

otherRecurring.name: Ordering Support Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, 3% of the pre-tax transaction amount for each transaction that is processed through our online ordering system

otherRecurring.name: Online Ordering Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $111 per month, plus a per transaction fee (currently, 0.04% per transaction)

otherRecurring.name: Supply Chain Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $0.61 to $0.91 per case purchased through certain Appointed Distributors

otherRecurring.name: Sublease Administration Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $200 per month (only if you sublease a Restaurant from us)

transferFee.amount: 50% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee if it is a Control Transfer; if it is a transfer to a related party or that is not a Control Transfer, 10% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee.

special: Many ancillary fees are paid to the franchisor or affiliates (Ordering Support Fee 3% of online/catering transactions, POS license/lease fees passed through at cost plus 0.5% admin, supply chain fee per case collected from distributors). If you sublease from the franchisor, a $200 monthly Sublease Administration Fee is added to rent.
